name: emerald-sequin-night-balcony
image_purpose: Nightlife fashion and social media portrait content

prompt.project_info: Create a luxury night-balcony fashion portrait using the required approved-adult face and composition reference.
prompt.main_subject: The same approved adult woman as the required face reference, in sleek high ponytail and clean glam makeup, with a confident downward side gaze. She wears the same emerald-green halter-neck full-length sequin gown with a form-fitting editorial silhouette and the same gold statement earrings with green stone detail.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 4:5 three-quarter-body portrait matching the reference side-profile angle, head tilt and hand placement behind the body. Keep the subject dominant with a balcony railing edge and blurred high-rise city skyline and streetlights as creamy bokeh; no readable signs.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft directional key from camera-left, minimal fill retaining facial detail, subtle cool city-ambient rim light, controlled specular sparkle on sequins, mixed warm city bokeh and neutral skin key.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic luxury-magazine night portrait, full-frame camera with 85mm f/1.8 lens, shallow depth of field, balanced dynamic range without HDR, high texture preservation, subtle 35mm film grain, no watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 4:5 luxury night-balcony fashion portrait using the same approved adult woman's face and identity as the attached reference image. Preserve the exact side-profile angle, head tilt, hand placement behind the body, sleek high ponytail, emerald-green halter-neck full-length sequin gown and gold statement earrings with green stone detail. Frame her as a dominant three-quarter-body subject against a high-rise balcony at night, with distant city skyline and streetlights as soft creamy bokeh and no readable signs. Use a soft directional key from camera-left, minimal fill, subtle cool city rim light, controlled sparkle on the sequins, mixed warm city bokeh and neutral skin key, balanced editorial realism, natural skin texture and subtle 35mm grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, fetish styling, nudity, minors, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed hands, duplicate subject, clipped sequin highlights, unreadable text, logos, watermark
